description: This file defines the Expanded formatter class for SCSS PHP processing, responsible for formatting SCSS code into an expanded, human-readable style with proper indentation and line breaks.

classes.name: Expanded
classes.description: A formatter class that outputs SCSS in an expanded, human-readable style with indentation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the formatter with default indentation, line break, and formatting characters.

methods.name: indentStr
methods.description: Returns the indentation string based on current indentation level.

methods.name: blockLines
methods.description: Formats a block of SCSS lines, handling indentation and line breaks, and processes comments.
